raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
[by Claude Code]

## Motivation

Since 2026-10-15, `1-gpu-5090` jobs have been failing with `No space left on device (os error 28)` (#44479). The pool moved to new vast.ai hosts that start with empty caches and small disks; #44383 says the trial machines have 32 GB. On these hosts, a few jobs are enough to fill the disk:

- `UV_LINK_MODE=copy` keeps three full copies of the CUDA torch stack:
  - the uv cache;
  - the kept venv `/opt/sglang-ci-py3.12`;
  - the build environment for the editable sglang install, which needs torch because it is in `[build-system].requires`.
- Nothing evicts Hugging Face checkpoints. For example, base-b 1-gpu-small loads `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct`, about 16 GB.
- The 5090 diffusion canary's `minimax_h3_t2va_consumer_budget_1gpu_5090` case downloads the 134 GiB MiniMax-H3 `FL2VA` variant on any host that doesn't have it cached.
- When the disk fills, the failure shows up deep inside uv, and nothing in the log says how much space was free.

This PR shrinks the install's footprint and makes 5090 hosts either free space or fail with a clear error. It does not remove the need to give these hosts enough disk.

## Modifications

1. **Hardlink instead of copy.** `scripts/ci/cuda/ci_install_dependency.sh` now sets `UV_LINK_MODE=hardlink` instead of `copy`. The venv and the build environment hardlink files from the uv cache, so the CUDA stack is stored once. When the cache and the venv are on different filesystems, uv falls back to copying and prints a warning; I checked both cases with uv 0.8.15. Hardlinks would let an in-place edit of an installed file change the cache too, but I found no CI step that edits installed files in place.
2. **New `scripts/ci/cuda/ensure_disk_headroom.sh`, run as the first install step.**
   - **Every CUDA runner:** print free space for the filesystems holding `/opt`, the uv cache, and the HF cache. When the lowest is below 40 GiB, run `uv cache prune`, capped at 5 minutes; it removes only entries nothing references.
   - **`SGLANG_CI_DISK_GUARD=strict`:** additionally:
     - evict least-recently-used HF repos until 40 GiB is free, skipping any repo used in the last 2 hours;
     - print the largest cache directories;
     - fail with an `::error::` if less than 10 GiB is still free.
   - **Where strict is set:** only for jobs whose `runs-on` is `1-gpu-5090`, in `_pr-test-stage.yml`, `pr-test-jit-kernel.yml`, `pr-test-multimodal-gen.yml`, `rerun-test.yml`, and `diffusion-ci-gt-gen.yml`. These hosts keep the HF cache on their own disk. On a cache volume shared by many hosts, eviction only moves the failure to the next job; `scripts/ci/amd/check_hf_cache_space.sh` documents this.
3. **New `scripts/ci/utils/evict_hf_cache.py`,** which uses only the standard library because it runs before the venv exists, plus a unit test, `test_evict_hf_cache.py`.
4. **Remove `minimax_h3_t2va_consumer_budget_1gpu_5090` from the per-PR 5090 canary** (the case and its 5090 perf baseline).
   - Per-PR CI no longer covers H3's constrained-placement path.
   - `flux_image_t2i_layerwise_cpu_offload_5090` still covers layerwise offload, with a small model.
   - The case can come back on a lane whose hosts have the checkpoint pre-cached.

Not changed: `ci_cleanup_venv.sh` still runs `uv cache prune --ci` when the disk is at least 85% full. With hardlinks, that frees less space, because entries also linked into the venv stay on disk, and later installs re-download what it removed. It is worth revisiting once the hosts have enough disk.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A, CI only.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A. On a runner with enough free space, the guard only runs a few `df` calls.

## Testing

- `python -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci/utils -p 'test_evict_hf_cache.py'`: both tests pass. Each one fails when I break the logic it guards (eviction order reversed, or the 2-hour window ignored).
- I ran `ensure_disk_headroom.sh` with the thresholds raised, against a temporary HF cache:
  - **Report mode:** exits 0.
  - **Strict mode:** evicts only the idle repo, keeps the recent one, and exits 1 with the error.
- uv 0.8.15 hardlinks on the same filesystem (the venv file and the cache file share an inode) and falls back to copying across filesystems.
- `pre-commit run --all-files` passes.
- Not yet run on a 5090 runner, and CI has not been triggered.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (N/A)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+#!/bin/bash
+# Report free disk before a CUDA CI install, and reclaim space when it runs low.
+#
+# Every runner: print free space on the filesystems the install and the tests
+# write to, and prune unreachable uv cache entries when space is low.
+# SGLANG_CI_DISK_GUARD=strict also evicts least-recently-used Hugging Face
+# checkpoints and fails the job when the disk is still too full afterwards.
+# Use strict only where the HF cache is local to the host: on a volume shared
+# by many hosts, eviction just moves the failure onto whichever job needed the
+# evicted checkpoint (see scripts/ci/amd/check_hf_cache_space.sh).
+
+set -uo pipefail
+shopt -s nullglob
+
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+
+# Estimate, not a measurement: a cold install unpacks about 15 GiB of CUDA
+# wheels, and one 8B bf16 checkpoint needs another 16 GiB.
+TARGET_FREE_GIB=40
+# Arbitrary floor; below it even an incremental install rarely finishes.
+MIN_FREE_GIB=10
+
+MODE="${SGLANG_CI_DISK_GUARD:-report}"
+HF_ROOT="${HF_HOME:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}"
+HF_HUB_DIR="${HF_HUB_CACHE:-${HF_ROOT}/hub}"
+
+find_uv() {
+    if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        command -v uv
+        return
+    fi
+    python3 -c 'import uv; print(uv.find_uv_bin())' 2>/dev/null || true
+}
+
+UV_BIN="$(find_uv)"
+if [ -n "$UV_BIN" ]; then
+    UV_CACHE="$("$UV_BIN" cache dir 2>/dev/null || true)"
+fi
+UV_CACHE="${UV_CACHE:-${UV_CACHE_DIR:-${HOME}/.cache/uv}}"
+
+# /opt holds the kept venv (ci_install_dependency.sh). /tmp is left out: it may be
+# a small tmpfs that evicting checkpoints cannot relieve.
+WATCHED_PATHS=(/opt "$UV_CACHE" "$HF_HUB_DIR")
+
+existing_ancestor() {
+    local path="$1"
+    while [ ! -e "$path" ]; do
+        path="$(dirname "$path")"
+    done
+    echo "$path"
+}
+
+lowest_free_gib() {
+    local lowest="" path free
+    for path in "${WATCHED_PATHS[@]}"; do
+        free="$(df -BG --output=avail "$(existing_ancestor "$path")" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | tr -dc '0-9')"
+        [ -n "$free" ] || continue
+        if [ -z "$lowest" ] || [ "$free" -lt "$lowest" ]; then
+            lowest="$free"
+        fi
+    done
+    echo "$lowest"
+}
+
+report() {
+    local path
+    local existing=()
+    for path in "${WATCHED_PATHS[@]}"; do
+        existing+=("$(existing_ancestor "$path")")
+    done
+    echo "=== Disk space ($1) ==="
+    # One row per filesystem: several watched paths usually share one.
+    df -h "${existing[@]}" 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR == 1 || !seen[$NF]++'
+}
+
+prune_uv_cache() {
+    [ -n "$UV_BIN" ] || return 0
+    # Bounded so a slow prune cannot eat the install step's timeout.
+    timeout 300 "$UV_BIN" cache prune || echo "WARNING: uv cache prune failed or timed out"
+}
+
+show_largest_caches() {
+    echo "=== Largest cache directories ==="
+    timeout 120 du -sh "$HF_ROOT" "$UV_CACHE" /opt/sglang-ci-* "${HOME}/.cache/flashinfer" \
+        /tmp/sglang-ci-* 2>/dev/null | sort -rh || true
+}
+
+main() {
+    echo "Disk guard mode: ${MODE}"
+    report "before"
+
+    local free
+    free="$(lowest_free_gib)"
+    if [ -z "$free" ]; then
+        echo "WARNING: could not read free space; skipping the disk guard"
+        return 0
+    fi
+    if [ "$free" -ge "$TARGET_FREE_GIB" ]; then
+        return 0
+    fi
+
+    echo "Lowest free space is ${free} GiB, below the ${TARGET_FREE_GIB} GiB target; reclaiming space"
+    prune_uv_cache
+    if [ "$MODE" = "strict" ]; then
+        python3 "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../utils/evict_hf_cache.py" \
+            --cache-dir "$HF_HUB_DIR" \
+            --target-free-gib "$TARGET_FREE_GIB" || echo "WARNING: HF cache eviction failed"
+        show_largest_caches
+    fi
+    report "after"
+
+    free="$(lowest_free_gib)"
+    if [ "$MODE" = "strict" ] && [ -n "$free" ] && [ "$free" -lt "$MIN_FREE_GIB" ]; then
+        echo "::error::Only ${free} GiB of disk is free on runner ${RUNNER_NAME:-unknown} after cleanup (need ${MIN_FREE_GIB} GiB). The disk is too small or filled by data this job cannot evict; the runner needs attention."
+        return 1
+    fi
+    return 0
+}
+
+main "$@"

@@ -0,0 +1,112 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Evict least-recently-used Hugging Face hub repos until the cache has room.
+
+Only for runners whose HF cache is local to the host; see
+scripts/ci/cuda/ensure_disk_headroom.sh. Stdlib only, because it runs before
+the CI venv exists.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import os
+import shutil
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Callable, NamedTuple
+
+_GIB = 1 << 30
+_REPO_PREFIXES = ("models--", "datasets--", "spaces--")
+# A job on another runner of the same host may still be reading the repo;
+# two hours matches the stale-download age in cleanup_hf_cache.py.
+_DEFAULT_MIN_IDLE_HOURS = 2.0
+
+
+class CachedRepo(NamedTuple):
+    path: Path
+    size_bytes: int
+    # Newest atime/mtime of any file. Under relatime, atime moves at most once
+    # a day, so this orders repos only roughly by last use.
+    last_used: float
+
+
+def _describe_repo(repo_dir: Path) -> CachedRepo:
+    size_bytes = 0
+    last_used = repo_dir.stat().st_mtime
+    for root, _, files in os.walk(repo_dir):
+        for name in files:
+            try:
+                st = os.lstat(os.path.join(root, name))
+            except OSError:
+                continue  # vanished mid-scan
+            size_bytes += st.st_blocks * 512
+            last_used = max(last_used, st.st_atime, st.st_mtime)
+    return CachedRepo(path=repo_dir, size_bytes=size_bytes, last_used=last_used)
+
+
+def scan_repos(cache_dir: Path) -> list[CachedRepo]:
+    return [
+        _describe_repo(entry)
+        for entry in cache_dir.iterdir()
+        if entry.is_dir() and entry.name.startswith(_REPO_PREFIXES)
+    ]
+
+

+    cache_dir: Path,

+    min_idle_seconds: float,
+    now: float,
+    free_bytes_fn: Callable[[], int],
+    remove_fn: Callable[[Path], None],

+    evicted = []
+    for repo in sorted(scan_repos(cache_dir), key=lambda r: r.last_used):
+        if free_bytes_fn() >= target_free_bytes:

+        if now - repo.last_used < min_idle_seconds:
+            break  # sorted by last use, so every remaining repo is newer
+        try:
+            remove_fn(repo.path)
+        except OSError as exc:
+            print(f"  Warning: could not evict {repo.path.name}: {exc}")
+            continue

+        print(
+            f"  Evicted {repo.path.name} ({repo.size_bytes / _GIB:.1f} GiB, "
+            f"idle {idle_hours:.1f} h)"

+    parser.add_argument("--cache-dir", type=Path, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--target-free-gib", type=float, required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--min-idle-hours", type=float, default=_DEFAULT_MIN_IDLE_HOURS)

+        f"Evicting least-recently-used repos from {args.cache_dir} "
+        f"until {args.target_free_gib:.0f} GiB is free"

+"""Unit tests for evict_hf_cache.evict_least_recently_used.
+
+Stdlib only, like the script under test:
+
+    python -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci/utils -p 'test_evict_hf_cache.py'
+"""
+
+import os
+import shutil
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import time
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+import evict_hf_cache as ehc  # noqa: E402
+
+HOUR = 3600.0
+GIB = 1 << 30
+
+
+def _make_repo(cache_dir: Path, name: str, last_used: float) -> None:
+    blob = cache_dir / name / "blobs" / "0123abcd"
+    blob.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    blob.write_bytes(b"\0" * 4096)
+    # Children first: creating an entry bumps its parent directory's mtime.
+    for path in (blob, blob.parent, blob.parent.parent):
+        os.utime(path, (last_used, last_used))
+
+
+class EvictLeastRecentlyUsedTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.cache_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
+        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.cache_dir)
+        self.now = time.time()
+        self.removed = []
+
+    def _evict(self, *, target_free_gib: int, min_idle_hours: float):
+        def remove(path: Path) -> None:
+            self.removed.append(path.name)
+            shutil.rmtree(path)
+
+        # Each eviction frees exactly 1 GiB, so the target counts evictions.
+        return ehc.evict_least_recently_used(
+            cache_dir=self.cache_dir,
+            target_free_bytes=target_free_gib * GIB,
+            min_idle_seconds=min_idle_hours * HOUR,
+            now=self.now,
+            free_bytes_fn=lambda: len(self.removed) * GIB,
+            remove_fn=remove,
+        )
+
+    def test_evicts_least_recently_used_first_and_stops_at_target(self):
+        _make_repo(self.cache_dir, "models--org--mid", self.now - 20 * HOUR)
+        _make_repo(self.cache_dir, "models--org--oldest", self.now - 30 * HOUR)
+        _make_repo(self.cache_dir, "models--org--newest", self.now - 10 * HOUR)
+
+        self._evict(target_free_gib=2, min_idle_hours=2)
+
+        self.assertEqual(self.removed, ["models--org--oldest", "models--org--mid"])
+        self.assertTrue((self.cache_dir / "models--org--newest").is_dir())
+
+    def test_never_evicts_a_repo_used_within_min_idle(self):
+        """A host's other runner may be loading a recent repo; deleting it
+        mid-load fails that job, so recency wins over the free-space target."""
+        _make_repo(self.cache_dir, "models--org--stale", self.now - 30 * HOUR)
+        _make_repo(self.cache_dir, "models--org--in-use", self.now - 0.5 * HOUR)
+        _make_repo(self.cache_dir, ".locks", self.now - 30 * HOUR)
+
+        self._evict(target_free_gib=100, min_idle_hours=2)
+
+        self.assertEqual(self.removed, ["models--org--stale"])
+        self.assertTrue((self.cache_dir / "models--org--in-use").is_dir())
+        self.assertTrue((self.cache_dir / ".locks").is_dir())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
